_doc: PreToolUse guard policy (scripts/lib/pretool-guard.mjs). Built-ins always deny: push to protected branches, force push, remote ref delete, recursive delete of roots/home/repository. Adapters add their own risk surface below. approval = allowed only with a lease for the exact command, created by a human with scripts/approve-high-risk.mjs. A rule matches the full command text by default; "match": "structure" ignores quoted free text such as commit messages.

approval.reason: Repository visibility, deletion or renaming is a public, owner-approved action.
Publishing or changing a release is a public, owner-approved action.
Infrastructure state changes need a reviewed plan and human approval.
